research_question: Under the frozen Formal G1 failure, is the dominant limitation closer to FEATURE_REPRESENTATION or MODEL_DECISION_FUNCTION?

hypotheses.H3: MIXED feature representation and model decision function limitation

review_report.status: Formal G1 failed; architecture frozen; full training blocked

approved_data_contract.event_population: training_eligibility=true in the frozen participant_eligibility_v3 event ledger
approved_data_contract.positive_label: window/event intersection >= 50 percent of the 15 s window
approved_data_contract.negative_label: approved cache label == 0; cache label == -1 is excluded from all supervised tasks
approved_data_contract.data_contract_identity: APPROVED; no label, eligibility, window, stride, or production-architecture changes

invariants: every eligible participant occurs in exactly one validation set
training participants are the complement of the validation participants
no participant, session, event identity, or window from outer validation enters classifier fitting

B.name: imu_temporal_probe_v1
B.definition: A concatenated with exactly the fixed temporal feature vector defined below; no A feature is removed or redefined
B.source_window: the same raw regularized 15 s window used to create its A row, located by the approved cache key and start/end timestamps

derived_signals.acc_diff_mag: 0 for the first sample, then Euclidean norm of successive ACC row differences
derived_signals.gyro_diff_mag: 0 for the first sample, then Euclidean norm of successive GYRO row differences

B.missing_value_policy: A sample is usable only when approved valid_mask is true and the signal is finite. Empty summaries, undefined autocorrelations, and undefined burst statistics are 0.0. No imputation, interpolation, scaling, or feature-wise normalization is applied in extraction.
B.normalization_policy: raw feature units are retained; classifier preprocessing is applied only inside each outer-train fit

coarse_temporal_subdivision.partitions: exact contiguous sample thirds of the 15 s, 10 Hz grid: indices [0,50), [50,100), [100,150); if the approved window grid differs, use floor/ceil boundaries that partition the exact ordered samples into three contiguous non-empty slices

definitions.std_population: population standard deviation of usable samples
definitions.mean_abs_successive_difference: mean(abs(x[i]-x[i-1])) over adjacent usable samples in original time order within the slice; 0 when fewer than two usable samples

burst_structure.threshold: per signal and window, median(usable signal) + 2.0 * population_std(usable signal); threshold is 0.0 when no usable samples
burst_structure.active_sample: usable signal strictly greater than its window threshold
burst_structure.minimum_burst_length: 2 consecutive active 10 Hz samples (0.2 s); shorter runs are inactive
burst_structure.peak_temporal_position: index of the earliest maximum usable signal divided by max(1, sample_count-1), in [0,1]; 0.0 when no usable sample

bounded_autocorrelation.definition: for each fixed lag, use pairs (t-lag,t) within the same contiguous usable run; center both values by the mean of all values participating in the pairs and divide their dot product by the product of their Euclidean norms
bounded_autocorrelation.undefined_policy: 0.0 if fewer than two pairs or either centered norm is zero

transition_contrast.definition: difference of slice means for the named ordered pair; use the same three contiguous thirds and usable-sample rule as coarse subdivision

B.shape_and_finiteness_contract: B is [n,183] float32/float64-compatible with exactly 72 appended temporal columns and all finite values

L.standard_scaler: fit_transform outer-train only; transform outer-validation only

N.class_imbalance: pass sklearn compute_sample_weight(class_weight='balanced', y=outer_train_labels) to fit; weights are computed from outer-train labels only; no resampling and no other weighting

diagnostic_classifiers.score_semantics: predict_proba[:,1] for LogisticRegression and HistGradientBoostingClassifier; scores are diagnostic ranking scores only and do not define a production threshold

hard_negative_control.source: frozen production CandidateModel outer-fold OOF score protocol, using existing fit_candidate_model configuration and the frozen Formal G1 outer folds
hard_negative_control.population: supervised negative cache rows (label == 0) in an outer-validation participant, scored by the model fit on outer-train participants only
hard_negative_control.hard_negative_rule: production OOF score >= 0.5; this fixed score cutoff is applied before fitting any diagnostic classifier and never depends on diagnostic scores
hard_negative_control.easy_negative_rule: for the optional control, select the same number of negative rows as hard negatives from the lowest frozen production OOF scores within the same outer-validation population, ties broken by stable row key (participant_id, start_ms, end_ms, cache_key)
hard_negative_control.sampling: use all rows satisfying the hard-negative rule; no post-hoc rebalancing; if an outer fold has no hard negatives, report unavailable and do not substitute a diagnostic-defined subgroup
hard_negative_control.circularity_guard: hard/easy membership is fixed from the frozen production OOF score and is never selected from A/B/L/N outputs

task_1_missing_positive_vs_hard_negative.positive_population: all supervised positive cache rows whose window intersects one of the 27 non-COVERED Formal G1 MissingEvent identities in review_report.event_audit.rows; MissingEvent taxonomy is AGGREGATION_FIRST or SCORE_THRESHOLD_FIRST
task_1_missing_positive_vs_hard_negative.fit_protocol: fit one diagnostic classifier on outer-train participants only, using the same task population definition restricted to outer-train participants; score outer-validation participants only

task_2_all_positive_vs_all_supervised_ne.fit_protocol: same participant-disjoint outer protocol as Task 1

task_3_participant_level_generalization.population: Task 2 held-out participant rows, with hard-negative rows identified by the frozen control

missing_event_audit.analysis: for every subgroup report A-L, A-N, B-L, B-N score distributions and threshold-free separability; do not rerun or modify production aggregation

metrics_and_stability.pooled_metrics: compute on concatenated held-out outer-validation rows only
metrics_and_stability.per_fold_metrics: compute independently in each outer fold
metrics_and_stability.participant_metrics: compute independently for each held-out participant when both classes are present; otherwise report null with the reason
metrics_and_stability.fold_delta: comparison minus the matched A/L baseline in the same outer fold and task
metrics_and_stability.participant_delta: comparison minus the matched A/L baseline for the same participant and task

stable_improvement.fold_direction: at least 4 of 5 finite fold deltas > 0
stable_improvement.participant_direction: at least 60 percent of comparable held-out participants have delta > 0 and improved_count > degraded_count
stable_improvement.hard_negative_guard: hard-negative AUROC delta must be >= -0.03 and hard-negative P90 score increase alone is not evidence of improvement
stable_improvement.single_participant_guard: no stable claim when the pooled change is attributable to one participant

metrics_and_stability.no_raw_score_increase_claim: if missing-positive scores increase while hard-negative scores increase approximately equally, classify the change as non-discriminative; ranking metrics and hard-negative deltas govern

comparison_logic.case_1: B-L and B-N both show stable improvement with hard-negative controls -> FEATURE_REPRESENTATION STRENGTHENED
comparison_logic.case_2: A-N shows stable strong improvement while B-L is approximately A-L and B-N is approximately A-N -> MODEL_DECISION_FUNCTION STRENGTHENED
comparison_logic.case_3: B-L improves, A-N improves, and B-N provides an additional stable benefit -> MIXED
comparison_logic.case_4: none of the four combinations shows stable participant-disjoint improvement -> BOUNDED_TEMPORAL_REPRESENTATION_HYPOTHESIS UNSUPPORTED
comparison_logic.inconclusive: if the cases conflict or stability criteria cannot be evaluated, report PROBE_RESULT=INCONCLUSIVE and stop

architecture_design_review_justified_onl: hard-negative discrimination does not materially worsen
improvement is not driven by one participant
B beats A in at least one matched classifier comparison
direction is reasonably stable under participant-disjoint evaluation
architecture_escalation.authorization: ARCHITECTURE DESIGN REVIEW only; no production change, no replacement of imu_stats_v1, no full training

required: deterministic fold assignment and participant-disjoint invariant
production artifacts and production behavior unchanged
verification.diagnostic_outputs: new files only under artifacts/g1-temporal-representation-probe-v1 and diagnostic code/tests only

stopping_rule.after_outer_evaluation: do not add temporal families, classifiers, parameters, sampling policies, participants, or thresholds
stopping_rule.if_unsupported: write BOUNDED_TEMPORAL_REPRESENTATION_HYPOTHESIS=UNSUPPORTED and return to root-cause review
stopping_rule.production_isolation: diagnostic result is never written into production code or cache
